_note: Sayyad is a real person and has no surname in this game. Gemini invented one; it has been removed. Never give any of the real characters (Sayyad, Zahra, Margaret, Adam Actell, Mike McDonald) an invented surname.

rivals.name: Sayyad
rivals.style: Screaming high-RPM precision, late braking into the apex, aggressive weaving on the wide boulevards.
rivals.whenLosing: Swears loudly, immediately claims his clutch was slipping, and demands a rematch at the next light.
rivals.fromWhere: 75 Denise-Friend, Aylmer. Eighteen, local legend, Zahra's older brother.

rivals.name: Mathieu 'Mat' Gendron
rivals.style: Reckless heavy-footed straight-line speed with no regard for brakes or suspension.
rivals.whenLosing: Leans on the horn, cuts a parking lot curb to shortcut the finish, and flips you off grinning.
rivals.fromWhere: The subdivisions off Boulevard Wilfrid-Lavigne. Seventeen, school friend.

rivals.name: Patrice 'Pato' Gagnon
rivals.style: Overpowered rear-drive sliding, far too much wheelspin off the line, straight-pipe intimidation.
rivals.whenLosing: Does a smoking donut in the nearest intersection to drown out your win.
rivals.fromWhere: Deschênes. Twenty-four, roofer, should not still be racing teenagers.

rivals.name: Éric 'Le Rat' Lévesque
rivals.style: Twitchy boost, terrifying passes on narrow gravel shoulders.
rivals.whenLosing: Pulls into an alley, throws the hood up, and mutters at vacuum hoses.
rivals.fromWhere: Out past Chemin Pink. Twenty-one, self-taught backyard mechanic.

rivals.name: Sophie 'La Reine' Tremblay
rivals.style: Smooth clinical European lines and flawless downshifts through the technical curves.
rivals.whenLosing: A calm nod from behind the sunglasses and two flashes of the high beams.
rivals.fromWhere: The riverside end of Aylmer. Nineteen, Heritage College student.

rivals.name: Kevin 'Bumper' Boucher
rivals.style: Bumper-to-bumper tailgating and paint-trading body checks in the narrow sections.
rivals.whenLosing: Tries to sideswipe your rear quarter on the last turn, then blames the road surface.
rivals.fromWhere: Val-Tétreau, on the Hull side. Eighteen, notorious for body damage.

rivals.name: Dave 'Subie' MacIntyre
rivals.style: Unstoppable on gravel, four-wheel slides through dirt corners, fearless in the rain.
rivals.whenLosing: Laughs out the window, sprays gravel at your windshield on the launch, shouts congratulations in English.
rivals.fromWhere: Around the marina and the sailing club. Eighteen, anglophone, skater.

rivals.name: Yanick 'Nitro' Larouche
rivals.style: Drafting, high-speed bridge sprints, surgical shifts at the redline.
rivals.whenLosing: Will not make eye contact at the line, rolls the tinted window up, leaves toward Ottawa.
rivals.fromWhere: Mont-Bleu, Hull. Twenty, Cégep de l'Outaouais.

rivals.name: Big Dan Beaulieu
rivals.style: Lumbering V8 momentum and wide cornering that occupies both lanes.
rivals.whenLosing: Slams a palm on the wheel, then offers to buy you a poutine at the casse-croûte.
rivals.fromWhere: Out Chemin Eardley. Twenty-five, runs heavy equipment at the gravel pit.

rivals.name: Chantal 'Flash' Roy
rivals.style: Agile slalom driving through traffic and fast handbrake turns around obstacles.
rivals.whenLosing: Cranks the stereo, laughs, and challenges you to double or nothing.
rivals.fromWhere: The Chemin d'Aylmer strip. Seventeen, works at the cinema in the Galeries.

rivals.name: Marc-André 'Marco' Côté
rivals.style: Momentum racing, impossible corner speed, taunting you with the top down.
rivals.whenLosing: Throws his hands up and complains that straightaways are for people with no talent.
rivals.fromWhere: Wrightville, downtown Hull. Nineteen, fine arts student.

rivals.name: Steve 'Mullet' Boucher
rivals.style: Brutal straight-line acceleration followed by sloppy panic braking at every corner.
rivals.whenLosing: Spins the tires until the cabin fills with smoke, stalls it, and kicks the door open.
rivals.fromWhere: Around Les Galeries de Hull. Twenty-six, still wearing his 1996 grad jacket.
